summary: Two cases. If h₂² < ℓ, take h = 0 and for γ an element of an inertia group above ℓ whose cyclotomic character is a generator b of (ℤ/ℓ)^×: it fixes E ⊂ ℚ(ζ_N) as N < ℓ, and cyc(γ)^a − 1 is a unit because b^a ≠ 1 for 0 < a < t < ℓ − 1. Otherwise take h = v_ℓ(Mk) and γ a Frobenius at a chosen place v of norm g_i not above ℓ: cyc(γ)^a − 1 = g_i^a − 1 divides Mk, which divides ℓ^{v_ℓ(Mk)} in ℤ_ℓ.

steps.claim: Split according to whether h₂² < ℓ (l).
steps.lean:
if l : D.h₂ ^ 2 < ℓ then IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard.elim fun b hb ↦
  (exists_inertia_cycChar_eq (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one
  (IsAlgClosed.lift (R := ℚ)).1) (ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime b).symm).elim fun γ i ↦ ⟨0, bot_le,
  .inr rfl, {γ with commutes' x := D.algebraMap_mem_cycloField x ⟨γ, cycCharMod_of_mem_inertiaGroup
  i.1 ((Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime out (D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound.trans_lt l) Fact.out).valuation_eq_one
  (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one _))⟩}, fun a h ↦ (IsUnit.of_map toZMod _ (by
    erw [val_pow_eq_pow_val, i.2]
    simpa using pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf h.1.ne' (by grind [orderOf_units, Nat.card_units,
      Nat.card_zmod, Nat.le_self_pow]))).dvd⟩ else (exists_chosen_notMem_placesDividing D ℓ).elim
  fun v ⟨i, _, hw, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨_, le_rfl, by lia, (v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.exists_isFrob _).imp
  fun φ hφ a ha ↦ by simpa [hφ.cycChar_eq ℓ (v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2
  hw.2), hi, pos, valuation] using (g_pow_sub_one_dvd_chosenGroupOrder D ⟨ha.1,
  ha.2.le.trans D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound⟩).natCast.trans (unitCoeff_spec (p := ℓ) out).dvd⟩

steps.claim: Case h₂² < ℓ. The finite group (ℤ/ℓ)^× is cyclic: let b be an element whose order is its cardinality ℓ − 1.
steps.lean:
IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard.elim fun b hb ↦
  (exists_inertia_cycChar_eq (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one
  (IsAlgClosed.lift (R := ℚ)).1) (ZMod.val_coe_unit_coprime b).symm).elim fun γ i ↦ ⟨0, bot_le,
  .inr rfl, {γ with commutes' x := D.algebraMap_mem_cycloField x ⟨γ, cycCharMod_of_mem_inertiaGroup
  i.1 ((Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime out (D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound.trans_lt l) Fact.out).valuation_eq_one
  (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one _))⟩}, fun a h ↦ (IsUnit.of_map toZMod _ (by
    erw [val_pow_eq_pow_val, i.2]
    simpa using pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf h.1.ne' (by grind [orderOf_units, Nat.card_units,
      Nat.card_zmod, Nat.le_self_pow]))).dvd⟩

steps.claim: An embedding of Ω into ℚ̄_ℓ (Ω is algebraic over ℚ) defines a place B of Ω at which ℓ has valuation < 1 (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one); the least natural representative val(b) of b is prime to ℓ. So there is γ in the inertia group of B in Gal(Ω/ℚ) with cyc_ℓ(γ) = val(b) (exists_inertia_cycChar_eq).

Take h = 0 (so h ≤ v_ℓ(Mk) and h = 0). The element γ fixes E, hence is an element of Gal(Ω/E): E lies in ℚ(ζ_N), N = D.cycloConductor (Data.algebraMap_mem_cycloField), and γ acts trivially on the N-th roots of unity (cycCharMod_of_mem_inertiaGroup), because it lies in the inertia group of B and N is a unit at B: N is prime to ℓ, since 0 < N ≤ h₂² < ℓ (magnitudes of the data, Data.nat_le_of_hasLogBound; Nat.Coprime.valuation_eq_one).
steps.lean:
⟨0, bot_le,
  .inr rfl, {γ with commutes' x := D.algebraMap_mem_cycloField x ⟨γ, cycCharMod_of_mem_inertiaGroup
  i.1 ((Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime out (D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound.trans_lt l) Fact.out).valuation_eq_one
  (valuation_comap_intQpBar_lt_one _))⟩},

steps.claim: For 0 < a < t, cyc_ℓ(γ)^a − 1 divides ℓ⁰ = 1, i.e. is a unit of ℤ_ℓ: its reduction modulo ℓ is b^a − 1 (cyc_ℓ(γ) = val(b)), which is non-zero because b^a ≠ 1, a being smaller than the order ℓ − 1 = |(ℤ/ℓ)^×| of b (grind, from 0 < a < t, t + k + 1 ≤ h₂ with k ≥ 1 (the global facts Data.k_add_t_add_one_le_h₂, Data.k_pos) and h₂ ≤ h₂² < ℓ); an element of ℤ_ℓ whose reduction is a unit is a unit.
steps.lean:
fun a h ↦ (IsUnit.of_map toZMod _ (by
    erw [val_pow_eq_pow_val, i.2]
    simpa using pow_ne_one_of_lt_orderOf h.1.ne' (by grind [orderOf_units, Nat.card_units,
      Nat.card_zmod, Nat.le_self_pow]))).dvd⟩

steps.claim: Case ℓ ≤ h₂². Let v be a chosen place of E above g, not above ℓ, with norm q_v = g_i for some i (exists_chosen_notMem_placesDividing).
steps.lean:
else (exists_chosen_notMem_placesDividing D ℓ).elim
  fun v ⟨i, _, hw, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨_, le_rfl, by lia, (v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.exists_isFrob _).imp
  fun φ hφ a ha ↦ by simpa [hφ.cycChar_eq ℓ (v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2
  hw.2), hi, pos, valuation] using (g_pow_sub_one_dvd_chosenGroupOrder D ⟨ha.1,
  ha.2.le.trans D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound⟩).natCast.trans (unitCoeff_spec (p := ℓ) out).dvd⟩

steps.claim: Take h = v_ℓ(Mk) (so h ≤ v_ℓ(Mk)); ℓ ≤ h₂² holds as h₂² < ℓ fails.
steps.lean: fun v ⟨i, _, hw, hi⟩ ↦ ⟨_, le_rfl, by lia,

steps.claim: Take γ = φ, an arithmetic Frobenius for q_v at a place of Ω over v (IsPlaceOver.exists_isFrob). As ℓ is a unit at v, cyc_ℓ(φ) = q_v = g_i (IsFrob.cycChar_eq). For 0 < a < t, g_i^a − 1 divides Mk (g_pow_sub_one_dvd_chosenGroupOrder, as 1 ≤ a ≤ t ≤ r·t by the magnitudes of the data), and in ℤ_ℓ Mk = u·ℓ^{v_ℓ(Mk)} with u a unit (PadicInt.unitCoeff_spec), so Mk divides ℓ^{v_ℓ(Mk)} = ℓ^h; hence cyc_ℓ(γ)^a − 1 = g_i^a − 1 divides ℓ^h.
steps.lean:
(v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.exists_isFrob _).imp
  fun φ hφ a ha ↦ by simpa [hφ.cycChar_eq ℓ (v.isPlaceOver_placeOver.valuation_natCast_eq_one_iff.2
  hw.2), hi, pos, valuation] using (g_pow_sub_one_dvd_chosenGroupOrder D ⟨ha.1,
  ha.2.le.trans D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound⟩).natCast.trans (unitCoeff_spec (p := ℓ) out).dvd⟩
